# Andrew O’Donohue

Postdoctoral Fellow, Princeton University  
Fellow, Carnegie Endowment  
Ph.D., Harvard University

[odonohue@princeton.edu](mailto:odonohue@princeton.edu)

...

My research studies law and courts, democracy and authoritarianism, and Middle East politics.

My research has been published in **_[The Journal of Democracy](https://www.journalofdemocracy.org/articles/how-courts-undermine-democracy/)_** , **_[Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences Nexus](https://academic.oup.com/pnasnexus/article/4/9/pgaf253/8245251)_** , and **_[The Middle East Journal](https://muse.jhu.edu/pub/119/article/988813)_** . My book, **[Democracies Divided: The Global Challenge of Political Polarization](https://www.brookings.edu/book/democracies-divided/)** , co-edited with Thomas Carothers, was published by the Brookings Institution Press. My writing has also been published by _**[The Atlantic](https://www.theatlantic.com/author/andrew-odonohue/)**_ , _**[Foreign Affairs](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/united-states/2019-09-25/how-americans-were-driven-extremes)**_ , _**[Foreign Policy](https://foreignpolicy.com/author/andrew-odonohue/)**_ ,
